beats.shot: extreme close-up on a black tarnished spoon
beats.does: holds up a dark, tarnished silver spoon
beats.says: This spoon is black with tarnish.

beats.does: pours household bleach into a bowl and drops the spoon in
beats.says: Soak it in bleach for ten minutes.

beats.does: lifts the spoon out, bright and shiny
beats.says: Bleach strips the tarnish right off.

beats.does: turns the gleaming spoon in the light
sets the spoon on a cloth
beats.says: Do this with all your silver.
